title: Eleven Weeks and One Road
subtitle: 地理地貌 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 地理地貌（自然生态·地理与地貌）
meta: 主题语境：地理地貌（自然生态·地理与地貌）　|　核心词汇：continent　|　正文 329 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 continent 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 my great-uncle ① crossed a continent by a road that was not finished, and he said the crossing was the whole of the journey. The ② continent, meaning the land and not the map, took eleven weeks and stayed that size; continent, he said, is the only thing on a globe that is judged by how long it takes to cross.

Every ③ continent in that atlas had the same fold, and the ④ continent at the end, meaning the one he never reached and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever asked about twice. Continent, my grandmother said, is nine parts fold and one part somebody willing to go; my great-uncle said the going is the part that fills eleven weeks.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the continent was the whole of the lecture, meaning the idea and not the land. The ⑥ continent, meaning the idea and not any of that, is the only thing in a lecture that everybody accepts and nobody questions; continent, she said, is either something you cross or the only word that means both a land and an idea. He said the idea is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ continent had become a line in a lecture list, and the list had become an argument about the fold. The ⑧ continent of the whole thing, my great-uncle wrote in July, was one road and thirty years of going; continent, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to ask. She said the asking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ continent I remember is the one at the end, which he described in 1967 and is still described as the most folded in the county. A ⑩ continent, my grandmother said in 1969, is the only thing that improves by being crossed; every continent, she said, is an idea that has agreed to look like a land. She said the idea was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 大陆（指那块陆地本身，与那张地图相对）
C. 固定搭配：cross a continent 横穿大陆
D. n. 洲（指那本地图册里每一块）
E. n. 洲（指末尾那一块）
F. n. 大陆（抽象：那片陆地的概念）
G. n. 大陆（指讲座清单里提到的那一块）
H. n. 陆块；板块（抽象总称）

items.q: crossed a continent by a road that was not finished
The continent, meaning the land and not the map
the continent was the whole of the lecture
the continent had become a line in a lecture list
The continent of the whole thing
A continent, my grandmother said in 1969

answers.why: cross a continent 意为“横穿大陆”，1953 年姑祖父沿着一条还没修完的路横穿了一块大陆。
continent 意为“大陆”，指那块陆地本身而不是那张地图，横穿花了十一周。
continent 指那本地图册里每一块大陆，每一块都有同样的折痕。
continent 指末尾那一块（他从未到达的那一块），是唯一有人问过两次的。
continent 意为“大陆”，母亲说那片大陆就是那场讲座的全部，指的是陆地的概念而不是那块土地。
continent 为抽象用法，指那片陆地的概念而不是那块土地，是讲座里人人都接受、却无人质疑的东西。
continent 意为“大陆”，指讲座清单里提到的那一块，到 1961 年这块大陆成了清单里的一行。
continent 意为“陆块、板块”，姑祖父七月写道，整件事的陆块是一条路三十年的行走。
continent 意为“大陆、洲”，我记得的是末尾那一块，他 1967 年描述的，至今仍被说成全县折痕最多的。
continent 为抽象总称，祖母说一块大陆是唯一会因为被横穿而变好的东西。

那块大陆，指的是那块陆地本身而不是那张地图，横穿花了十一周，并且一直是那个规模。（continent）
那本地图册里每一块大陆都有同样的折痕。（continent）

母亲说那片大陆就是那场讲座的全部，指的是陆地的概念而不是那块土地。（continent）
1969 年祖母说，一块大陆是唯一会因为被横穿而变好的东西。（continent）
answers: In 1953 my great-uncle crossed a continent by a road that was not finished, and he said the crossing was the whole of the journey.
The continent, meaning the land and not the map, took eleven weeks and stayed that size.
Every continent in that atlas had the same fold.
The continent at the end, meaning the one he never reached and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever asked about twice.
My mother said the continent was the whole of the lecture, meaning the idea and not the land.
A continent, my grandmother said in 1969, is the only thing that improves by being crossed.
